scientific_integrity: General invariant-projection criterion credited to Dilworth, Kutzarova and Ostrovskii. Exact finite character and rational-current checks are independently replayable. No outside audit claimed.
scientific_limitations: Finite, unweighted, real edge spaces for five Platonic graphs only. No classification of non-invariant minimizers or extension to weighted or non-Platonic graphs. Bibliographic priority has residual uncertainty.
title: Sharp relative cut and cycle projection constants for all Platonic graphs
